environment: Playwright 1.64.1 Chromium, software WebGL (SwiftShader), reduced motion; desktop 1440x1000 and an emulated 390x844 touch phone
mode: Example mode on a free local port with a scratch data folder and an empty environment: no credentials, no provider request, no write
steps: Load, wait for data-ready, close the journal, set World settings > Time of day to Day
For each area: choose it in Areas, then View > Zoom in up to six times (1.2x a step, closest 2.8x), settling after each step
Capture the view; the before image used the committed src/app/main.js at 3b1d02a, the others the fixed file
